brief: 🚨 BREAKOUT: trycua/cua — open-source computer-use 2.0 with cross-OS fleets and benchmarks. This is the infrastructure layer for AI agents doing real work in real OS environments. Ship now before the incumbents copy it.
💡 Adjacent bet: mattpocock/skills and addyosmani/agent-skills — production-grade engineering skills are the missing moat for any AI coding agent. First to curate + monetize a skills marketplace wins.
⚡ Timing signal: deepseek-harness and orca show plugin/agent orchestration is commoditizing fast. Differentiation is shifting to vertical depth (code review, office files, architecture diagrams).
📊 Watch: dream-num/univer — unified runtime for AI agents manipulating office files. If they nail the DX, they become the Zapier for AI-native document workflows.
